items.title: 68087_Cliff Leeman oral history interview
items.q: oh, George Harris on trombone, from Detroit

ctx.x: How many pieces were with you in the band?

14 pieces. Let's see, three trumpets, two trombones -- oh, George Harris on trombone, from Detroit, and I'm trying to remember the names of consequence that I can place my finger on now -- we rehearsed a bunch of orchestrations, because we all said we'd go with them. They offered me $65 a week, and I never heard of such money. So we all said yes, naturally. We were getting $25 or $30 with Hank Vogini, which was on scale. And who should walk in but a few arrangements -- we had stock orchestrations we were cutting…
Now let's let people know who
